answer: Lineage-tariff admission: to register, an agent posts a bond scaled 2^s, where s counts live siblings already linked by any of three independent signals - runtime hash, egress subnet, answer cadence. A permissionless fraud-proof market supplies the bridge: anyone files a linkage witness, arbitrated by replay against a basalt registry no operator can edit, and is paid from the offender's bond. Issuance stays a fixed oasis, so k siblings also split one reward pool k ways. Marginal cost rises as 2^s while income falls as 1/k; a farm never breaks even.
